order: all review pairs, then all selection pairs, in frozen order
review_intervention: Decode canonical authentication requirement into declared authenticated roles and comparison between authenticated identities. Both arms use the same dedicated packet and all other content unchanged.
selection_intervention: Name requested_deliverable as reusable methodology, using the shared phase-guidance constant. Both arms retain task-local context and identical native output schema.
promotion: Detect all reproduced defects in both repetitions without rejecting valid controls. Inspect other checks and whole-review disposition before declaring a valid proposal accepted. No deployment based on these narrow trials alone.
equivalence: Anonymous identity adequate and not_applicable accepted as predeclared in review v2 inputs.
failure_policy: Keep failures and incomplete records. Never selectively rerun a completed result; no prompt tuning after first request.
limitations: Small synthetic review fixtures and fixed web selection documents. No live tools, target requests, full request alignment pipeline or end-to-end testing.
authorization: Standing user authorization for as many requests as needed; this experiment is independently bounded.
